game: Castle of Illusion Starring Mickey Mouse

packages.name: Castle of Illusion widescreen + Practice+
packages.author: segarecomp-patches contributors
packages.gameplay: Unchanged, except Practice+, a power restore the player invokes
packages.supported_scope: Authored widescreen scenery in the 17 verified scrolling scenes, the game's own sprites drawn beside the picture, and the user-invoked Practice+ power restore.
limitations: Applies only to the one image this entry lists (USA, Europe); any other image is refused by digest.
Authored scenery covers the 17 verified scrolling scenes only; menus, cutscenes, level loads and any other layout use the host's generic extension.
Practice+ writes three declared guest-memory ranges when the player invokes it; nothing else is written.
Needs a segarecomp build that can install schema 3 / native ABI 2 packages (product ADRs 0311 to 0315, mod install); no tagged segarecomp release (v0.8.0 and earlier) can. See docs/installation.md.
